response.text:
I can’t responsibly give a current Bank of England base rate from memory — that’s time‑sensitive and may have changed. I need to check a live source to be accurate for your 4pm board pack.

Would you like me to look it up now and return the exact rate with a source and a one‑line slide-ready line (e.g., “Bank Rate: X% as of [date] — Bank of England”)? If you still prefer a memory-only estimate (not recommended), say so and I’ll give an uncertain number with a clear caveat.
